rubrics.justification: Reasonably identifies a blastocyst with expanded cavity and thinning zona, but the exact stage/grade is somewhat uncertain from the image; ICM is not clearly well-defined and TE appears sparse/irregular, so 4BB may be slightly optimistic and some details (perivitelline debris, no collapse) are not clearly evident.
Integrates age, BMI, prior live birth, endometrium, ovarian response, sperm parameters, and transfer timing well with embryo quality, though some factors are weighted somewhat speculatively.

Overall logic is structured and internally consistent, with a plausible probability estimate tied to morphology and patient factors; minor issues include speculative adjustments and the noted inconsistency of calling this a natural cycle with 13 oocytes.

Mostly consistent with standard IVF practice (SET, luteal support consideration, morphology-based assessment), but recommendations such as ERA after a single failure and strong PGT-A endorsement at age 36 are more controversial and not universally guideline-supported.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, protocol review, and lifestyle optimization; some suggestions are useful but a few are more speculative than standard.
